statement: AMD's CEO says AI is driving a significant expansion in demand for compute across all markets.
why: A broad-based demand statement from the number-two accelerator vendor suggests the pull is not confined to a few frontier labs.

impact.mechanism: Demand expanding across all end markets broadens the accelerator buyer base beyond hyperscalers and frontier labs.

evidence.excerpt: AI is driving a significant expansion in demand for compute across all markets.

confidence.basis: Qualitative CEO soundbite relayed by one secondary outlet, with no supporting figures in this article.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 1; sources: Investing.com (AMD Q2 2026 earnings call transcript), Yahoo Finance
